title: Catching tuberculosis near Charlie Christian
summary: Sauter suspects he caught TB from Christian in the Goodman rehearsal control room.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Yes. And also I got sick. I got TB--I must have caught it from Charlie Christian, I can't think of any other way, because Benny used to have rehearsals and it was always in a padded cell, like this, and off there was a room the size of a kitchen where the control room was, and it had a couch in there and an engineer and all the equipment. I'd be in there with the engineer and Charlie would come in there and go to sleep. He was already in the terminal stages of this stuff; in a closed room like that and if you were run down you'd catch it.
Shortly after that, a year after that, I got sick. A year and a half maybe, and Charlie died at that period.
He didn't take care of himself.
He didn't take care of himself, but he didn't know how. You know it's psychological, you have to relax and let
the body take over and if you're tense it doesn't work either.
Lionel (inaudible). They went on a fishing boat with Lionel and Lionel's wife Peggy and Charlie Christian and Irving Goodman and he was really sick then--
It was the autumn after that that the episode in the control room took place.
